title: Mindwalk – Replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase
claim: Show HN: Mindwalk – Replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase
why_good: Mindwalk addresses the complex challenge of visualizing codebase interactions, which can significantly enhance team collaboration and onboarding.
value: Companies could pay for premium features or subscriptions to improve developer productivity and reduce onboarding time, leading to cost savings.
risk: The technology could be seen as a niche tool that larger IDEs or code management platforms might easily integrate, overshadowing Mindwalk's standalone offering.
